name: Residence Visa (Student)

requirements.blocker_text: Admission to a university or an approved educational institution in Sri Lanka.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission at a recognized Sri Lankan institution.

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the source located in this build; one of 13 Residence Visa subcategories, typically tied to course duration

sources.title: Department of Immigration & Emigration, Sri Lanka -- General Information on Visa: Residence Visa's Student subcategory covers university and approved-institution students, among 13 total Residence Visa subcategories (Employment, Investment, Student, Religious, Family, Medical, Court, and others)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Sri Lanka). Published on tier-1 sourcing (Department of Immigration & Emigration), though the site's own index page gives only category names, not granular fee/duration detail for each of the 13 Residence Visa subcategories -- disclosed as a genuine gap rather than filled in with a guess.
